build: The year's edge: work, seed and stock across the New Year. A planting belongs to the season of its first harvest (a live tray: the day it is ready; a planting that gives nothing to pick, its own date), one rule in js/seedlib.js (seasonOf). Seeds, Tasks, "Take back everything recorded" and the Nursery's supplies take the plantings dated in the plan's year, as before, and those of its season wherever their work falls: a tray batch sown in December for January, or garlic planted the fall before, is now counted and listed. Nothing dated in the year is taken away: a sowing late in the year for a January harvest is still counted where it is sown, and the foot of Seeds says so. A task on a day of another year says which, and work for a later season says that season. Work of a planting dated before the plan's year that was due before today and is not recorded is not brought onto the lists as late by itself: it is one line, which opens it, and Seeds counts it for the plan and not as still to sow. A sowing put off may move into the season it is for. A planting recorded as sown counts for the plan the seed recorded as used. The Forecast stays a calendar: stock picked before Jan 1 and still to sell in the year is in it, on a line of its own under its crop (carried in), and counted once in every total and the worth; what is to sell after Dec 31 counts in the next year and is said behind the page's "?". Nothing is stored.

changes.did: Work and seed across the New Year: a December sowing for January's trays is on Tasks in its own week and counted in Seeds, and stock picked in December and still to sell in January shows on the Forecast as carried in.
steps: On Tasks, go to the week of a December sowing for a January delivery: it is listed, its row saying it is in the year before.
On Seeds, the foot says how many plantings dated this year are first picked next season (still counted here), or are earlier work with nothing recorded, when there are any.
On the Forecast in January, a crop picked in December that keeps has a line Carried in under it; the season's worth counts it once.
